protocol.noise_type: Gaussian white noise only; no synthetic ECG, no EMG or electrode-motion simulation
protocol.noise_stage: raw mV before baseline removal, bandpass and training-global normalization
protocol.snr_definition: per-lead demeaned signal power / added noise power, before preprocessing

training.threshold_selection: clean validation only, unchanged coarse grid

distillation.teacher_input: same selected record and noise view as student
distillation.teacher_logits: new view-aligned cache, never legacy clean-only cache

deployment_selection.guard_reference: existing distilled seed44 FP32 evaluated in FP32
deployment_selection.fallback: if no candidate passes guard, export best experimental candidate without replacing firmware

quantization.method: static signed INT8 QDQ, per-channel weights, MinMax

protocol.normalization: reuse and verify moments fitted on the 17084 clean training records only
